masquerade.title: Forward and masquerade the zone traffic
masquerade.description: Forward the traffic of the zone with the node address as source. The interface must be a tun created by add-tun. The policy name is the zone name with the -masq suffix, so the zone name is limited to 13 characters. true is the same as {"internet": true}.

internet.title: Allow the Internet
internet.description: Private networks stay closed unless a destination lists them

destinations.title: Allowed destinations
destinations.description: IPv4 address or network, with an optional port and protocol
